name: Daraku Shita Shinjitsu
source: You play as a secret investigator sent by the legendary superhero base IMMORTAL to uncover the traitor among them. Interrogate the three suspected heroes and find who is betraying his own valors for the sake of evil!
translation: 你扮演一名由传奇超级英雄基地IMMORTAL派出的秘密调查员，去揭露其中的叛徒。审问三位疑似英雄，找出谁为了邪恶而背叛了自己的勇气！
